**A note on framing before you write:** this project models a route's *exposure*
to fixed sensors. Please describe the problem in those terms — "the route scored
X expected reads where a comparable route scores Y" — rather than in terms of
avoiding detection. See CONTRIBUTING.md. Reports framed the other way will be
asked to reword before they can be reviewed on the merits.
